scope: Sizing repair of waiting, greeting (waving), and Oops (failed) in the existing-frame v1 candidate
review_method: Compared updated and previous contact sheets.
Viewed all 18 affected PNG frames individually at their native 192 by 208 cell resolution.
Compared selected previous waiting, greeting, and Oops frames at native resolution and inspected the focused sizing preview.
Independently compared source transforms, frame cells, unaffected rows, and decoded sprite formats.

visual_observations.waiting: Torso remains a consistent size and horizontal position through the reaching poses. Source pose changes remain visible without the previous artificial growth in the middle.
visual_observations.greeting: Flower costume is visibly smaller and balanced with the other standing states. All four frames remain intact and readable.
visual_observations.oops: Seated character remains centred in all eight frames while the intentional ghost moves independently. Hands, feet, and ghost remain inside the cell.

accepted_scope: Only supplied source artwork and ordinary resizing or registration were used.
Existing v1 animation semantics and intentional costumes, props, and effects are accepted.
